"""
screens/manufacturer_list_screen.py

Manufacturer List Screen/Controller - Medical ERP V2

Responsibilities (and ONLY these -- project rule "No SQL. No business
logic."):
    - Load ui/manufacturer_list.ui via ui/ui_manufacturer_list.py
    - Connect signals to handler methods
    - Call engines/manufacturer_engine.py for every data operation
    - Populate the table from what the Engine returns
    - Drive Search / Filter / Soft Delete / Restore / Refresh
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence, QShortcut
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QTableWidgetItem, QWidget

from engines.exceptions import RecordNotFoundError
from engines.manufacturer_engine import ManufacturerDTO, ManufacturerEngine
from screens.manufacturer_form_screen import ManufacturerFormScreen
from ui.ui_manufacturer_list import Ui_ManufacturerListWidget
from utils.integration_adapters import confirm, get_current_user_id, show_error, show_success
from utils.manufacturer_form_helpers import dto_to_table_row, status_filter_value

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300


class ManufacturerListScreen(QWidget):
    """Manufacturer Master list/search/filter screen. Opens ManufacturerFormScreen for Add/Edit."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None, engine: Optional[ManufacturerEngine] = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.ui = Ui_ManufacturerListWidget()
        self.ui.setupUi(self)

        self._engine = engine or ManufacturerEngine()
        self._rows: list[ManufacturerDTO] = []

        self._search_debounce_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._search_debounce_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._search_debounce_timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh)

        self._connect_signals()
        self._setup_shortcuts()
        self.refresh()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Wiring
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.ui.txtSearch.textChanged.connect(self._on_search_text_changed)
        self.ui.cmbStatusFilter.currentTextChanged.connect(self.refresh)
        self.ui.chkShowDeleted.toggled.connect(self.refresh)
        self.ui.btnRefresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)
        self.ui.tblManufacturer.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._on_selection_changed)
        self.ui.tblManufacturer.doubleClicked.connect(self._on_edit_clicked)
        self.ui.btnAdd.clicked.connect(self._on_add_clicked)
        self.ui.btnEdit.clicked.connect(self._on_edit_clicked)
        self.ui.btnDelete.clicked.connect(self._on_delete_clicked)
        self.ui.btnRestore.clicked.connect(self._on_restore_clicked)
        self.ui.btnClose.clicked.connect(self._on_close_clicked)

    def _setup_shortcuts(self) -> None:
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+N"), self).activated.connect(self._on_add_clicked)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+F"), self).activated.connect(self.ui.txtSearch.setFocus)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("F5"), self).activated.connect(self.refresh)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Delete"), self).activated.connect(self._on_delete_clicked)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Escape"), self).activated.connect(self._on_close_clicked)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Search / Filter / Refresh
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _on_search_text_changed(self, _text: str) -> None:
        self._search_debounce_timer.start(SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        search_text = self.ui.txtSearch.text().strip() or None
        status = status_filter_value(self.ui.cmbStatusFilter.currentText())
        include_deleted = self.ui.chkShowDeleted.isChecked()

        try:
            rows, total = self._engine.search_manufacturers(
                search_text=search_text,
                status=status,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                page=1,
                page_size=500,
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Failed to load manufacturer list.")
            show_error(self, "Manufacturer Master", f"Failed to load manufacturers: {exc}")
            return

        self._rows = rows
        self._populate_table(rows)
        self.ui.lblRecordCount.setText(f"{total} manufacturer(s) found")

    def _populate_table(self, rows: list[ManufacturerDTO]) -> None:
        table = self.ui.tblManufacturer
        table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        table.setRowCount(0)
        for row_index, dto in enumerate(rows):
            table.insertRow(row_index)
            for col_index, value in enumerate(dto_to_table_row(dto)):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                item.setData(Qt.UserRole, dto.manufacturer_id)
                if dto.is_deleted:
                    item.setForeground(Qt.gray)
                table.setItem(row_index, col_index, item)
        table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self._on_selection_changed()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Selection state -> button enablement
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _selected_dto(self) -> Optional[ManufacturerDTO]:
        selected_ranges = self.ui.tblManufacturer.selectedItems()
        if not selected_ranges:
            return None
        manufacturer_id = selected_ranges[0].data(Qt.UserRole)
        for dto in self._rows:
            if dto.manufacturer_id == manufacturer_id:
                return dto
        return None

    def _on_selection_changed(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        has_selection = dto is not None
        is_deleted = bool(dto and dto.is_deleted)

        self.ui.btnEdit.setEnabled(has_selection and not is_deleted)
        self.ui.btnDelete.setEnabled(has_selection and not is_deleted)
        self.ui.btnRestore.setEnabled(has_selection and is_deleted)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # CRUD actions
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _on_add_clicked(self) -> None:
        dialog = ManufacturerFormScreen(self, manufacturer_id=None, engine=self._engine)
        if dialog.exec():
            self.refresh()

    def _on_edit_clicked(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        if dto is None or dto.is_deleted:
            return
        dialog = ManufacturerFormScreen(self, manufacturer_id=dto.manufacturer_id, engine=self._engine)
        if dialog.exec():
            self.refresh()

    def _on_delete_clicked(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        if dto is None or dto.is_deleted:
            return
        if not confirm(
            self, "Delete Manufacturer", f"Delete manufacturer '{dto.manufacturer_name}'?\n\nThis can be restored later."
        ):
            return
        try:
            self._engine.delete_manufacturer(dto.manufacturer_id, current_user_id=get_current_user_id())
        except RecordNotFoundError as exc:
            show_error(self, "Manufacturer Master", str(exc))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Failed to delete manufacturer %s.", dto.manufacturer_id)
            show_error(self, "Manufacturer Master", f"Failed to delete manufacturer: {exc}")
        else:
            show_success(self, "Manufacturer Master", f"Manufacturer '{dto.manufacturer_name}' deleted.")
            self.refresh()

    def _on_restore_clicked(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        if dto is None or not dto.is_deleted:
            return
        try:
            restored = self._engine.restore_manufacturer(dto.manufacturer_id, current_user_id=get_current_user_id())
        except RecordNotFoundError as exc:
            show_error(self, "Manufacturer Master", str(exc))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Failed to restore manufacturer %s.", dto.manufacturer_id)
            show_error(self, "Manufacturer Master", f"Failed to restore manufacturer: {exc}")
        else:
            show_success(self, "Manufacturer Master", f"Manufacturer '{restored.manufacturer_name}' restored.")
            self.refresh()

    def _on_close_clicked(self) -> None:
        self.close()


__all__ = ["ManufacturerListScreen"]


================================================================================
FILE: screens/master_manage_screen.py

"""
screens/master_manage_screen.py

Generic Lookup Master Management Dialog - Medical ERP V2

Fills the gap Item Master Part 1/2 left open: there was a generic
SimpleMasterEngine/Model/Validator for Category, Sub Category, Item Group,
Manufacturer, Unit, Generic, and Tax Master -- but no screen to actually
add/edit/remove rows in any of them. Rather than writing seven near-
identical management screens, ONE generic dialog drives all seven (same
"No Duplicate Logic" reasoning already used for the Model/Engine/Validator
layers), configured by the same `MasterTableConfig` + `SimpleMasterEngine`
pair the rest of the module already uses.

Responsibilities (and ONLY these, per "No SQL. No business logic."):
    - List / search / status-filter / show-deleted toggle
    - Add / Edit inline form (Code, Name, Remarks, Status)
    - Soft Delete / Restore
    - For scoped tables (Sub Category, scoped by Category), a required
      parent-scope selector drives both the list filter and the save payload

Everything else -- uniqueness, mandatory fields, defaults -- is decided by
the injected SimpleMasterEngine/Validator, exactly like every other screen
in this codebase.

SESSION MANAGER: `current_user_id` is a required constructor parameter,
same contract as every other screen here -- this dialog does not look it
up itself.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence, QShortcut
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMessageBox,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from engines.exceptions import DuplicateRecordError, RecordNotFoundError, ValidationError
from engines.simple_master_engine import MasterDTO, SimpleMasterEngine
from utils.combo_helpers import make_searchable

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MasterManageDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Generic Add/Edit/Delete/Restore dialog for one simple lookup master.

    `engine` must be a SimpleMasterEngine instance for the table being
    managed (e.g. `category_engine()`, `manufacturer_engine()`, ...).

    `scope_engine` + `scope_label` are only needed for a scoped table like
    Sub Category (scoped by Category): pass the PARENT's SimpleMasterEngine
    (e.g. `category_engine()`) and a label ("Category"). The dialog then
    shows a mandatory parent-selector combo, uses it to filter the list,
    and includes it in every save/uniqueness check via `scope_id`.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: Optional[QWidget],
        engine: SimpleMasterEngine,
        entity_label: str,
        current_user_id: int,
        scope_engine: Optional[SimpleMasterEngine] = None,
        scope_label: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        if current_user_id is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "MasterManageDialog requires current_user_id explicitly -- it "
                "does not look this up itself."
            )
        self._engine = engine
        self._entity_label = entity_label
        self._current_user_id = current_user_id
        self._scope_engine = scope_engine
        self._scope_label = scope_label
        self._is_scoped = scope_engine is not None

        self._rows: list[MasterDTO] = []
        self._selected_id: Optional[int] = None

        self.setWindowTitle(f"Manage {entity_label}")
        self.resize(640, 480)
        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()
        self._setup_shortcuts()

        if self._is_scoped:
            self._populate_scope_combo()
        self.refresh()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # UI construction (no .ui file -- this dialog is new, built directly)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)

        # -- Filter row -----------------------------------------------------
        filter_row = QHBoxLayout()
        if self._is_scoped:
            filter_row.addWidget(QLabel(f"{self._scope_label}:"))
            self.cmbScope = QComboBox()
            filter_row.addWidget(self.cmbScope, 2)
        self.txtSearch = QLineEdit()
        self.txtSearch.setPlaceholderText(f"Search {self._entity_label}...")
        filter_row.addWidget(self.txtSearch, 3)
        self.chkShowDeleted = QCheckBox("Show Deleted")
        filter_row.addWidget(self.chkShowDeleted)
        root.addLayout(filter_row)

        # -- Table ------------------------------------------------------------
        self.tblMaster = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.tblMaster.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Code", "Name", "Status", "Remarks"])
        self.tblMaster.setSelectionBehavior(QTableWidget.SelectRows)
        self.tblMaster.setSelectionMode(QTableWidget.SingleSelection)
        self.tblMaster.setEditTriggers(QTableWidget.NoEditTriggers)
        self.tblMaster.horizontalHeader().setStretchLastSection(True)
        root.addWidget(self.tblMaster, 1)

        # -- Inline Add/Edit form -----------------------------------------
        form_row1 = QHBoxLayout()
        form_row1.addWidget(QLabel("Code:"))
        self.txtCode = QLineEdit()
        form_row1.addWidget(self.txtCode, 1)
        form_row1.addWidget(QLabel("Name:"))
        self.txtName = QLineEdit()
        form_row1.addWidget(self.txtName, 2)
        form_row1.addWidget(QLabel("Status:"))
        self.cmbStatus = QComboBox()
        self.cmbStatus.addItems(["Active", "Inactive"])
        form_row1.addWidget(self.cmbStatus)
        root.addLayout(form_row1)

        form_row2 = QHBoxLayout()
        form_row2.addWidget(QLabel("Remarks:"))
        self.txtRemarks = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.txtRemarks.setMaximumHeight(50)
        form_row2.addWidget(self.txtRemarks)
        root.addLayout(form_row2)

        self.lblValidationMessage = QLabel("")
        self.lblValidationMessage.setStyleSheet("color: #b00020;")
        root.addWidget(self.lblValidationMessage)

        # -- Buttons ------------------------------------------------------
        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btnSave = QPushButton("Save")
        self.btnUpdate = QPushButton("Update")
        self.btnClear = QPushButton("Clear")
        self.btnDelete = QPushButton("Delete")
        self.btnRestore = QPushButton("Restore")
        self.btnClose = QPushButton("Close")
        for b in (self.btnSave, self.btnUpdate, self.btnClear, self.btnDelete, self.btnRestore, self.btnClose):
            btn_row.addWidget(b)
        root.addLayout(btn_row)

        self._set_form_mode(editing=False)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.txtSearch.textChanged.connect(self.refresh)
        self.chkShowDeleted.toggled.connect(self.refresh)
        if self._is_scoped:
            self.cmbScope.currentIndexChanged.connect(self.refresh)
        self.tblMaster.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._on_selection_changed)
        self.btnSave.clicked.connect(self._on_save_clicked)
        self.btnUpdate.clicked.connect(self._on_save_clicked)
        self.btnClear.clicked.connect(self._on_clear_clicked)
        self.btnDelete.clicked.connect(self._on_delete_clicked)
        self.btnRestore.clicked.connect(self._on_restore_clicked)
        self.btnClose.clicked.connect(self.accept)

    def _setup_shortcuts(self) -> None:
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+S"), self).activated.connect(self._on_save_clicked)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Escape"), self).activated.connect(self.accept)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Scope (parent) combo -- Sub Category's Category selector, etc.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _populate_scope_combo(self) -> None:
        self.cmbScope.clear()
        for dto in self._scope_engine.list_active():
            self.cmbScope.addItem(dto.name, dto.id)
        make_searchable(self.cmbScope)

    def _current_scope_id(self) -> Optional[int]:
        if not self._is_scoped:
            return None
        return self.cmbScope.currentData()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # List / refresh
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        if self._is_scoped and self._current_scope_id() is None:
            self._rows = []
            self._populate_table([])
            return
        search_text = self.txtSearch.text().strip() or None
        include_deleted = self.chkShowDeleted.isChecked()
        rows = self._engine.search(search_text=search_text, include_deleted=include_deleted)
        if self._is_scoped:
            scope_id = self._current_scope_id()
            rows = [r for r in rows if r.extra.get(self._scope_extra_key()) == scope_id]
        self._rows = rows
        self._populate_table(rows)

    def _scope_extra_key(self) -> str:
        # Sub Category's extra_columns includes "category_id" -- this is the
        # only scoped table today, so this is a small, explicit mapping
        # rather than a guess based on scope_label.
        return "category_id"

    def _populate_table(self, rows: list[MasterDTO]) -> None:
        table = self.tblMaster
        table.setRowCount(0)
        for row_index, dto in enumerate(rows):
            table.insertRow(row_index)
            values = [dto.code or "", dto.name or "", "Deleted" if dto.is_deleted else dto.status, dto.remarks or ""]
            for col_index, value in enumerate(values):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                item.setData(Qt.UserRole, dto.id)
                if dto.is_deleted:
                    item.setForeground(Qt.gray)
                table.setItem(row_index, col_index, item)
        self._on_selection_changed()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Selection -> form + button state
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _selected_dto(self) -> Optional[MasterDTO]:
        selected = self.tblMaster.selectedItems()
        if not selected:
            return None
        record_id = selected[0].data(Qt.UserRole)
        for dto in self._rows:
            if dto.id == record_id:
                return dto
        return None

    def _on_selection_changed(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        if dto is None:
            self.btnDelete.setEnabled(False)
            self.btnRestore.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self._selected_id = dto.id
        self.txtCode.setText(dto.code or "")
        self.txtName.setText(dto.name or "")
        self.cmbStatus.setCurrentText(dto.status or "Active")
        self.txtRemarks.setPlainText(dto.remarks or "")
        self._set_form_mode(editing=not dto.is_deleted)
        self.btnDelete.setEnabled(not dto.is_deleted)
        self.btnRestore.setEnabled(dto.is_deleted)

    def _set_form_mode(self, editing: bool) -> None:
        """editing=True -> Update is the active save action; False -> Save (Add)."""
        self.btnSave.setEnabled(not editing)
        self.btnUpdate.setEnabled(editing)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Add / Edit
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _on_clear_clicked(self) -> None:
        self._selected_id = None
        self.tblMaster.clearSelection()
        self.txtCode.clear()
        self.txtName.clear()
        self.cmbStatus.setCurrentText("Active")
        self.txtRemarks.clear()
        self.lblValidationMessage.setText("")
        self._set_form_mode(editing=False)
        self.txtName.setFocus()

    def _on_save_clicked(self) -> None:
        self.lblValidationMessage.setText("")

        if self._is_scoped and self._current_scope_id() is None:
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(f"Select a {self._scope_label} first.")
            return

        payload = {
            "code": self.txtCode.text().strip(),
            "name": self.txtName.text().strip(),
            "status": self.cmbStatus.currentText(),
            "remarks": self.txtRemarks.toPlainText().strip(),
        }
        scope_id = self._current_scope_id()
        if self._is_scoped:
            payload[self._scope_extra_key()] = scope_id

        try:
            if self._selected_id is not None:
                self._engine.update(self._selected_id, payload, self._current_user_id, scope_id=scope_id)
            else:
                self._engine.create(payload, self._current_user_id, scope_id=scope_id)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText("\n".join(exc.errors))
            return
        except DuplicateRecordError as exc:
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(str(exc))
            return
        except RecordNotFoundError as exc:
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(str(exc))
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Unexpected error saving %s.", self._entity_label)
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(f"Unexpected error: {exc}")
            return

        self._on_clear_clicked()
        self.refresh()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Delete / Restore
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _on_delete_clicked(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        if dto is None or dto.is_deleted:
            return
        confirmed = QMessageBox.question(
            self, f"Delete {self._entity_label}",
            f"Delete '{dto.name}'?\n\nThis can be restored later.",
        ) == QMessageBox.Yes
        if not confirmed:
            return
        try:
            self._engine.delete(dto.id, self._current_user_id)
        except RecordNotFoundError as exc:
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(str(exc))
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Failed to delete %s %s.", self._entity_label, dto.id)
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(f"Failed to delete: {exc}")
            return
        self._on_clear_clicked()
        self.refresh()

    def _on_restore_clicked(self) -> None:
        dto = self._selected_dto()
        if dto is None or not dto.is_deleted:
            return
        try:
            self._engine.restore(dto.id, self._current_user_id)
        except RecordNotFoundError as exc:
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(str(exc))
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Failed to restore %s %s.", self._entity_label, dto.id)
            self.lblValidationMessage.setText(f"Failed to restore: {exc}")
            return
        self._on_clear_clicked()
        self.refresh()


__all__ = ["MasterManageDialog"]

# screens/purchase_invoice_form_screen.py
from __future__ import annotations
import logging
from typing import Optional, List

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QComboBox, QPushButton,
    QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QDoubleSpinBox, QMessageBox, QHeaderView
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PurchaseInvoiceFormScreen(QDialog):
    """
    Minimal Purchase Invoice form (Phase-1).
    Notes:
    - This screen is purposely minimal: the engine performs validation and persistence.
    - When user links a PO, we pre-fill lines from that PO (if available) via purchase_order_engine.get_purchase_order().
    """

    def __init__(self, parent, engine, purchase_order_engine, supplier_engine, item_model):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._engine = engine
        self._po_engine = purchase_order_engine
        self._supplier_engine = supplier_engine
        self._item_model = item_model

        self.setWindowTitle("Create Purchase Invoice")
        self.resize(1000, 600)

        header_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        header_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Supplier:"))
        self.cmb_supplier = QComboBox()
        header_layout.addWidget(self.cmb_supplier)

        header_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Link PO:"))
        self.cmb_po = QComboBox()
        header_layout.addWidget(self.cmb_po)

        self.btn_load_po = QPushButton("Load PO")
        header_layout.addWidget(self.btn_load_po)

        # Lines table (simplified)
        self.tbl = QTableWidget(0, 9)
        self.tbl.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Item ID", "Item", "Batch No", "Expiry M", "Expiry Y", "Qty", "Free Qty", "Purchase Rate", "Discount %"])
        self.tbl.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.tbl.setColumnHidden(0, True)

        footer = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_save = QPushButton("Save Invoice")
        self.btn_close = QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.btn_save)
        footer.addWidget(self.btn_close)

        main = QVBoxLayout()
        main.addLayout(header_layout)
        main.addWidget(self.tbl)
        main.addLayout(footer)
        self.setLayout(main)

        # signals
        self.btn_load_po.clicked.connect(self._on_load_po_clicked)
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self._on_save_clicked)
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.close)

        self._populate_suppliers()
        self._populate_po_dropdown()

    def _populate_suppliers(self):
        self.cmb_supplier.clear()
        try:
            suppliers = []
            if hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "list_active"):
                suppliers = self._supplier_engine.list_active()
            elif hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "get_active_companies"):
                suppliers = self._supplier_engine.get_active_companies()
            else:
                suppliers = []
        except Exception:
            suppliers = []
        self.cmb_supplier.addItem("Select Supplier", None)
        for s in suppliers or []:
            if isinstance(s, dict):
                self.cmb_supplier.addItem(s.get("supplier_name") or s.get("supplier_code") or str(s.get("supplier_id")), s.get("supplier_id"))
            else:
                self.cmb_supplier.addItem(str(s), None)

    def _populate_po_dropdown(self):
        self.cmb_po.clear()
        self.cmb_po.addItem("None", None)
        try:
            # fetch recent Draft/Sent POs for convenience; adapt API if needed
            rows, total = self._po_engine.search_purchase_orders(page=1, page_size=200)
            for r in rows:
                label = f"{r.get('po_number')} - {r.get('supplier_name')}"
                self.cmb_po.addItem(label, r.get('purchase_order_id'))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _on_load_po_clicked(self):
        po_id = self.cmb_po.currentData()
        if not po_id:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No PO", "Please select a PO to load.")
            return
        try:
            dto = self._po_engine.get_purchase_order(po_id)
            if not dto:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Not found", "Selected PO not found.")
                return
            # Clear table and add PO lines
            self.tbl.setRowCount(0)
            for ln in dto.lines:
                row = self.tbl.rowCount()
                self.tbl.insertRow(row)
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(ln.item_id)))
                item_name = ""
                try:
                    item_row = self._item_model.get_by_id(ln.item_id)
                    item_name = item_row.get("item_name") if item_row else ""
                except Exception:
                    item_name = ""
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 1, QTableWidgetItem(item_name))
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 2, QTableWidgetItem("AUTO-BATCH"))  # user may override
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 3, QTableWidgetItem("1"))
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 4, QTableWidgetItem("2083"))
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 5, QTableWidgetItem(str(ln.ordered_qty)))
                self.tbl.setItem(row, 6, QTableWidgetItem("0"))
                rate_widget = QDoubleSpinBox()
                rate_widget.setRange(0, 99999999)
                rate_widget.setDecimals(2)
                rate_widget.setValue(float(ln.rate or 0))
                self.tbl.setCellWidget(row, 7, rate_widget)
                disc_widget = QDoubleSpinBox()
                disc_widget.setRange(0, 100)
                disc_widget.setDecimals(2)
                disc_widget.setValue(0.0)
                self.tbl.setCellWidget(row, 8, disc_widget)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Load PO failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not load PO: {exc}")

    def _collect_form(self):
        supplier_id = self.cmb_supplier.currentData()
        if not supplier_id:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Validation", "Please choose a supplier.")
            return None
        lines = []
        for r in range(self.tbl.rowCount()):
            try:
                item_id = int(self.tbl.item(r, 0).text())
            except Exception:
                continue
            batch_no = self.tbl.item(r, 2).text() if self.tbl.item(r, 2) else ""
            expiry_m = int(self.tbl.item(r, 3).text()) if self.tbl.item(r, 3) else 0
            expiry_y = int(self.tbl.item(r, 4).text()) if self.tbl.item(r, 4) else 0
            qty = float(self.tbl.item(r, 5).text()) if self.tbl.item(r, 5) else 0
            free_qty = float(self.tbl.item(r, 6).text()) if self.tbl.item(r, 6) else 0
            rate_widget = self.tbl.cellWidget(r, 7)
            purchase_rate = float(rate_widget.value()) if rate_widget else 0.0
            disc_widget = self.tbl.cellWidget(r, 8)
            discount_percent = float(disc_widget.value()) if disc_widget else 0.0
            if qty <= 0 and free_qty <= 0:
                continue
            lines.append({
                "item_id": item_id,
                "batch_no": batch_no,
                "expiry_month": expiry_m,
                "expiry_year": expiry_y,
                "qty": qty,
                "free_qty": free_qty,
                "purchase_rate": purchase_rate,
                "discount_percent": discount_percent,
                "mrp": 0,
                "sale_rate": 0
            })
        if not lines:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Validation", "No invoice lines provided.")
            return None

        payload = {
            "supplier_id": supplier_id,
            "invoice_number": "",  # user should set; UI simplified for example
            "invoice_date_bs": None,
            "lines": lines,
            "total_freight_amount": 0,
            "total_other_charges": 0,
            "remarks": None,
        }
        return payload

    def _on_save_clicked(self):
        payload = self._collect_form()
        if not payload:
            return
        try:
            dto = self._engine.create_purchase_invoice(payload, current_user_id=1)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Saved", f"Purchase Invoice created: {dto.internal_ref_number}")
            self.close()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Invoice save failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Failed to save invoice: {exc}")

# screens/purchase_invoice_list_screen.py
from __future__ import annotations
import logging
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QPushButton, QMessageBox, QHeaderView, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QComboBox
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PurchaseInvoiceListScreen(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent, engine, supplier_engine):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._engine = engine
        self._supplier_engine = supplier_engine
        self.setWindowTitle("Purchase Invoices")
        self.resize(1000, 600)

        top_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        top_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Supplier:"))
        self.cmb_supplier = QComboBox()
        top_layout.addWidget(self.cmb_supplier)
        self.btn_refresh = QPushButton("Refresh")
        top_layout.addWidget(self.btn_refresh)

        self.tbl = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self.tbl.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Invoice ID", "Ref No", "Supplier", "Grand Total", "Status", "Actions"])
        self.tbl.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.tbl.setColumnHidden(0, True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout()
        layout.addLayout(top_layout)
        layout.addWidget(self.tbl)
        self.setLayout(layout)

        self.btn_refresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)
        self._populate_suppliers()
        self.refresh()

    def _populate_suppliers(self):
        self.cmb_supplier.clear()
        self.cmb_supplier.addItem("All", None)
        try:
            suppliers = []
            if hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "list_active"):
                suppliers = self._supplier_engine.list_active()
            for s in suppliers:
                if isinstance(s, dict):
                    self.cmb_supplier.addItem(s.get("supplier_name") or s.get("supplier_code"), s.get("supplier_id"))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def refresh(self):
        try:
            supplier_id = self.cmb_supplier.currentData()
            rows, total = self._engine.search_purchase_invoices(search_text=None, supplier_id=supplier_id, status=None, include_deleted=False, page=1, page_size=200)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Invoice search failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Failed to load invoices: {exc}")
            return

        self.tbl.setRowCount(0)
        for r in rows:
            row = self.tbl.rowCount()
            self.tbl.insertRow(row)
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("purchase_invoice_id"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 1, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("internal_ref_number") or r.get("invoice_number"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 2, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("supplier_name") or r.get("supplier_id"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 3, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("grand_total"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 4, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("status"))))

            btn_view = QPushButton("View")
            btn_cancel = QPushButton("Cancel")
            widget = QWidget()
            h = QHBoxLayout()
            h.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
            h.addWidget(btn_view)
            h.addWidget(btn_cancel)
            widget.setLayout(h)
            self.tbl.setCellWidget(row, 5, widget)

            inv_id = r.get("purchase_invoice_id")
            btn_view.clicked.connect(lambda _, pid=inv_id: self._on_view(pid))
            btn_cancel.clicked.connect(lambda _, pid=inv_id: self._on_cancel(pid))

    def _on_view(self, invoice_id: int):
        try:
            dto = self._engine.get_purchase_invoice(invoice_id)
            if not dto:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Not found", "Invoice not found.")
                return
            lines = "\n".join([f"{l.item_id} qty:{l.qty} free:{l.free_qty} rate:{l.purchase_rate}" for l in dto.lines])
            QMessageBox.information(self, f"Invoice {dto.internal_ref_number}", f"Supplier: {dto.supplier_id}\nTotal: {dto.grand_total}\n\nLines:\n{lines}")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("View invoice failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not view invoice: {exc}")

    def _on_cancel(self, invoice_id: int):
        resp = QMessageBox.question(self, "Confirm", "Cancel this invoice? (soft-delete)")
        if resp != QMessageBox.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self._engine.cancel_purchase_invoice(invoice_id, current_user_id=1, reason="Cancelled via UI")
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Cancelled", "Invoice cancelled (soft-delete).")
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Cancel invoice failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not cancel invoice: {exc}")

# screens/purchase_order_form_screen.py
from __future__ import annotations
import webbrowser
import urllib.parse
import logging
from typing import Optional, List

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QComboBox,
    QPushButton, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QSpinBox, QDoubleSpinBox,
    QMessageBox, QHeaderView
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PurchaseOrderFormScreen(QDialog):
    """
    Purchase Order form dialog (Phase-1).
    - Loads low-stock suggestions via PurchaseOrderEngine.get_low_stock_suggestions()
    - Allows editing suggested qty, adding manual items (simple add UI)
    - Save -> PurchaseOrderEngine.create_purchase_order()
    - After save shows "Send via WhatsApp / Email" buttons (which only build URLs and open webbrowser)
    Note: This is UI glue only. Validation and persistence live in the engines.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget], engine, supplier_engine, item_lookup_registry) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Create Purchase Order")
        self.resize(900, 600)
        self._engine = engine
        self._supplier_engine = supplier_engine
        self._item_lookup = item_lookup_registry

        # Header UI
        header_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        header_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Supplier:"))
        self.cmb_supplier = QComboBox()
        header_layout.addWidget(self.cmb_supplier)
        header_layout.addStretch()
        self.btn_add_item = QPushButton("+ Add Item")
        header_layout.addWidget(self.btn_add_item)

        # Table for lines
        self.tbl = QTableWidget(0, 7)
        self.tbl.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Item ID", "Item", "Current", "Minimum", "Suggested", "Qty to Order", "Rate"])
        self.tbl.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.tbl.setColumnHidden(0, True)  # hide item_id column visually if desired

        # Bottom actions
        actions_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_save = QPushButton("Save Purchase Order")
        self.btn_whatsapp = QPushButton("Send via WhatsApp")
        self.btn_email = QPushButton("Send via Email")
        self.btn_close = QPushButton("Close")
        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_save)
        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_whatsapp)
        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_email)
        actions_layout.addStretch()
        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_close)

        # Assemble
        main = QVBoxLayout()
        main.addLayout(header_layout)
        main.addWidget(self.tbl)
        main.addLayout(actions_layout)
        self.setLayout(main)

        # Signals
        self.btn_add_item.clicked.connect(self._on_add_item_manually_clicked)
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self._on_save_clicked)
        self.btn_whatsapp.clicked.connect(self._on_send_whatsapp_clicked)
        self.btn_email.clicked.connect(self._on_send_email_clicked)
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.close)

        # Load supplier list and suggestions
        self._populate_supplier_combo()
        self._load_low_stock_suggestions()

        # Hold last created PO id for send actions
        self._last_po_id: Optional[int] = None

    def _populate_supplier_combo(self):
        # Try a few likely APIs on supplier_engine; adjust to your supplier_engine API.
        self.cmb_supplier.clear()
        try:
            if hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "get_active_companies"):
                rows = self._supplier_engine.get_active_companies()
            elif hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "list_active"):
                rows = self._supplier_engine.list_active()
            elif hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "search_suppliers"):
                rows, _ = self._supplier_engine.search_suppliers(None, None, None, False, 1, 100)
            else:
                rows = []
        except Exception:
            rows = []

        # rows may be list of dicts or list of tuples; map safely
        for r in rows or []:
            if isinstance(r, dict):
                display = r.get("supplier_name") or r.get("supplier_code") or str(r.get("supplier_id"))
                supplier_id = r.get("supplier_id")
            else:
                # fallback to tuple-like
                display = str(r)
                supplier_id = None
            self.cmb_supplier.addItem(display, supplier_id)

    def _load_low_stock_suggestions(self):
        try:
            suggestions = self._engine.get_low_stock_suggestions()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Failed to load low stock suggestions")
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", f"Could not load suggestions: {exc}")
            suggestions = []

        self.tbl.setRowCount(0)
        for s in suggestions:
            self._add_suggestion_row(s)

    def _add_suggestion_row(self, s):
        row = self.tbl.rowCount()
        self.tbl.insertRow(row)

        # item_id (hidden)
        item_id_item = QTableWidgetItem(str(s.item_id))
        item_id_item.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled)
        self.tbl.setItem(row, 0, item_id_item)

        # item name
        itm = QTableWidgetItem(s.item_name)
        itm.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled)
        self.tbl.setItem(row, 1, itm)

        # current stock
        cur = QTableWidgetItem(str(s.current_stock))
        cur.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled)
        self.tbl.setItem(row, 2, cur)

        # minimum
        mn = QTableWidgetItem(str(s.minimum_stock))
        mn.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled)
        self.tbl.setItem(row, 3, mn)

        # suggested (read-only)
        sug = QTableWidgetItem(str(s.suggested_qty))
        sug.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled)
        self.tbl.setItem(row, 4, sug)

        # qty to order (editable spin)
        spin = QSpinBox()
        spin.setRange(0, 1000000)
        spin.setValue(max(0, int(s.suggested_qty)))
        self.tbl.setCellWidget(row, 5, spin)

        # rate (editable)
        rate = QDoubleSpinBox()
        rate.setRange(0, 99999999)
        rate.setDecimals(2)
        rate.setValue(0.0)
        self.tbl.setCellWidget(row, 6, rate)

    def _on_add_item_manually_clicked(self):
        # Very simple manual add: let item_lookup_registry provide a (id, name)
        try:
            picker = self._item_lookup  # expected to expose search UI or a helper
            # If it provides a simple search(list) function, you can open a custom dialog.
            # For now we'll prompt for item id via a blocking input (quick path).
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QInputDialog
            item_id, ok = QInputDialog.getInt(self, "Add Item", "Enter Item ID:")
            if not ok:
                return
            # fetch item_name from item_model
            try:
                im = self._item_lookup  # if registry exposes lookup, else fallback to ItemModel
                if hasattr(self._item_lookup, "get_item_by_id"):
                    item_row = self._item_lookup.get_item_by_id(item_id)
                else:
                    from models.item_model import ItemModel
                    item_row = ItemModel().get_by_id(item_id)
                item_name = item_row.get("item_name") if item_row else f"Item {item_id}"
                current_stock = float(item_row.get("total_stock") or 0) if item_row else 0
                minimum_stock = float(item_row.get("minimum_stock") or 0) if item_row else 0
            except Exception:
                item_name = f"Item {item_id}"
                current_stock = 0
                minimum_stock = 0
            suggestion = type("S", (), {
                "item_id": item_id,
                "item_name": item_name,
                "current_stock": current_stock,
                "minimum_stock": minimum_stock,
                "suggested_qty": max(0, int(minimum_stock - current_stock))
            })
            self._add_suggestion_row(suggestion)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Add item failed")
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", f"Could not add item: {exc}")

    def _collect_form_values(self):
        # Build payload expected by engine.create_purchase_order()
        supplier_id = self.cmb_supplier.currentData()
        if supplier_id is None:
            # attempt to parse text if data missing
            supplier_text = self.cmb_supplier.currentText()
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Validation", "Please select a supplier.")
            return None

        lines = []
        for r in range(self.tbl.rowCount()):
            item_id = int(self.tbl.item(r, 0).text())
            qty_widget = self.tbl.cellWidget(r, 5)
            rate_widget = self.tbl.cellWidget(r, 6)
            ordered_qty = int(qty_widget.value()) if qty_widget else 0
            rate = float(rate_widget.value()) if rate_widget else 0.0
            if ordered_qty <= 0:
                continue  # skip unchecked rows
            lines.append({
                "item_id": item_id,
                "ordered_qty": ordered_qty,
                "rate": rate,
                "is_auto_suggested": True,
            })
        if not lines:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Validation", "No items selected to order.")
            return None

        payload = {
            "po_number": None,
            "supplier_id": supplier_id,
            "order_date_bs": None,  # engine will stamp if missing
            "lines": lines,
            "remarks": None,
        }
        return payload

    def _on_save_clicked(self):
        payload = self._collect_form_values()
        if not payload:
            return
        try:
            current_user_id = 1  # TODO: replace with actual current user id from integration adapter
            dto = self._engine.create_purchase_order(payload, current_user_id)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Saved", f"Purchase Order created: {dto.po_number}")
            # Save last PO id
            self._last_po_id = dto.purchase_order_id
            # allow immediate sending
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Failed to save PO")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Failed to save purchase order: {exc}")

    def _on_send_whatsapp_clicked(self):
        if not self._last_po_id:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Not Sent", "Save the Purchase Order first before sending.")
            return
        try:
            text_map = self._engine.build_supplier_message(self._last_po_id)
            # Get supplier mobile (best-effort)
            supplier_id = self.cmb_supplier.currentData()
            mobile = ""
            try:
                supplier = self._supplier_engine.get_supplier(supplier_id)
                mobile = supplier.get("mobile_no") if supplier else ""
            except Exception:
                mobile = ""
            if not mobile:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Mobile", "Supplier mobile number is not available.")
                return
            url = f"https://wa.me/{mobile}?text={urllib.parse.quote(text_map['whatsapp_text'])}"
            webbrowser.open(url)
            # mark sent
            current_user_id = 1
            self._engine._model  # touch for debugging
            try:
                # Mark via engine if exists
                self._engine._model  # no-op
                self._engine._model  # keep consistent
            except Exception:
                pass
            # call purchase_order_engine.mark_sent via engine reference
            try:
                # We don't have the PO id on engine return in this simplified flow; use stored id
                self._engine._purchase_order_engine.mark_sent(self._last_po_id, "whatsapp", current_user_id)
            except Exception:
                # fallback: try to mark via purchase_order engine itself (if accessible)
                pass
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Sent", "WhatsApp link opened.")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("WhatsApp send failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not build/send WhatsApp message: {exc}")

    def _on_send_email_clicked(self):
        if not self._last_po_id:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Not Sent", "Save the Purchase Order first before sending.")
            return
        try:
            text_map = self._engine.build_supplier_message(self._last_po_id)
            supplier_id = self.cmb_supplier.currentData()
            email = ""
            try:
                supplier = self._supplier_engine.get_supplier(supplier_id)
                email = supplier.get("email") if supplier else ""
            except Exception:
                email = ""
            if not email:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Email", "Supplier email is not available.")
                return
            subject = urllib.parse.quote(text_map["email_subject"])
            body = urllib.parse.quote(text_map["email_body"])
            url = f"mailto:{email}?subject={subject}&body={body}"
            webbrowser.open(url)
            # mark sent
            try:
                self._engine._purchase_order_engine.mark_sent(self._last_po_id, "email", 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Sent", "Email client opened.")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Email send failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not build/send Email message: {exc}")

# screens/purchase_order_list_screen.py
from __future__ import annotations
import webbrowser
import urllib.parse
import logging
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QComboBox, QPushButton,
    QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QMessageBox, QHeaderView
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PurchaseOrderListScreen(QWidget):
    """
    Simple list screen to browse purchase orders and send whatsapp/email links.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent, engine, supplier_engine):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._engine = engine
        self._supplier_engine = supplier_engine

        self.setWindowTitle("Purchase Orders")
        self.resize(1000, 600)

        top_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        top_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Supplier:"))
        self.cmb_supplier = QComboBox()
        top_layout.addWidget(self.cmb_supplier)
        top_layout.addStretch()
        self.btn_refresh = QPushButton("Refresh")
        top_layout.addWidget(self.btn_refresh)

        self.tbl = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self.tbl.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["PO ID", "PO Number", "Supplier", "Status", "Created At", "Actions"])
        self.tbl.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.tbl.setColumnHidden(0, True)

        main = QVBoxLayout()
        main.addLayout(top_layout)
        main.addWidget(self.tbl)
        self.setLayout(main)

        self.btn_refresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)
        self._populate_supplier_combo()
        self.refresh()

    def _populate_supplier_combo(self):
        self.cmb_supplier.clear()
        try:
            if hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "list_active"):
                suppliers = self._supplier_engine.list_active()
            elif hasattr(self._supplier_engine, "get_active_companies"):
                suppliers = self._supplier_engine.get_active_companies()
            else:
                suppliers = []
        except Exception:
            suppliers = []
        self.cmb_supplier.addItem("All", None)
        for s in suppliers or []:
            if isinstance(s, dict):
                self.cmb_supplier.addItem(s.get("supplier_name") or s.get("supplier_code") or str(s.get("supplier_id")), s.get("supplier_id"))
            else:
                self.cmb_supplier.addItem(str(s), None)

    def refresh(self):
        try:
            supplier_id = self.cmb_supplier.currentData()
            rows, total = self._engine.search_purchase_orders(search_text=None, supplier_id=supplier_id, status=None, include_deleted=False, page=1, page_size=200)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Failed to search purchase orders")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Failed to load purchase orders: {exc}")
            return

        self.tbl.setRowCount(0)
        for r in rows:
            row = self.tbl.rowCount()
            self.tbl.insertRow(row)
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("purchase_order_id"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 1, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("po_number"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 2, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("supplier_name") or r.get("supplier_id"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 3, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("status"))))
            self.tbl.setItem(row, 4, QTableWidgetItem(str(r.get("created_at_ad"))))

            # Actions cell: WhatsApp, Email, View, Cancel
            actions_widget = QWidget()
            layout = QHBoxLayout()
            btn_wa = QPushButton("📱")
            btn_email = QPushButton("✉")
            btn_view = QPushButton("View")
            btn_cancel = QPushButton("Cancel")
            layout.addWidget(btn_wa)
            layout.addWidget(btn_email)
            layout.addWidget(btn_view)
            layout.addWidget(btn_cancel)
            layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
            actions_widget.setLayout(layout)
            self.tbl.setCellWidget(row, 5, actions_widget)

            purchase_order_id = r.get("purchase_order_id")
            btn_wa.clicked.connect(lambda _, pid=purchase_order_id: self._on_whatsapp_clicked(pid))
            btn_email.clicked.connect(lambda _, pid=purchase_order_id: self._on_email_clicked(pid))
            btn_view.clicked.connect(lambda _, pid=purchase_order_id: self._on_view_clicked(pid))
            btn_cancel.clicked.connect(lambda _, pid=purchase_order_id: self._on_cancel_clicked(pid))

    def _on_whatsapp_clicked(self, purchase_order_id: int):
        try:
            text_map = self._engine.build_supplier_message(purchase_order_id)
            # Lookup supplier mobile
            # We assume engine or supplier_engine can return supplier row
            po = self._engine.get_purchase_order(purchase_order_id)
            supplier_id = po.supplier_id if po else None
            mobile = ""
            if supplier_id:
                try:
                    s = self._supplier_engine.get_supplier(supplier_id)
                    mobile = s.get("mobile_no") if s else ""
                except Exception:
                    mobile = ""
            if not mobile:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Mobile", "Supplier mobile not available.")
                return
            url = f"https://wa.me/{mobile}?text={urllib.parse.quote(text_map['whatsapp_text'])}"
            webbrowser.open(url)
            # mark sent
            try:
                self._engine._purchase_order_engine.mark_sent(purchase_order_id, "whatsapp", 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Opened", "WhatsApp link opened.")
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Failed to open WhatsApp link")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not open WhatsApp link: {exc}")

    def _on_email_clicked(self, purchase_order_id: int):
        try:
            text_map = self._engine.build_supplier_message(purchase_order_id)
            po = self._engine.get_purchase_order(purchase_order_id)
            supplier_id = po.supplier_id if po else None
            email = ""
            if supplier_id:
                try:
                    s = self._supplier_engine.get_supplier(supplier_id)
                    email = s.get("email") if s else ""
                except Exception:
                    email = ""
            if not email:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Email", "Supplier email not available.")
                return
            subject = urllib.parse.quote(text_map["email_subject"])
            body = urllib.parse.quote(text_map["email_body"])
            url = f"mailto:{email}?subject={subject}&body={body}"
            webbrowser.open(url)
            try:
                self._engine._purchase_order_engine.mark_sent(purchase_order_id, "email", 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Opened", "Email client opened.")
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Failed to open Email link")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not open Email link: {exc}")

    def _on_view_clicked(self, purchase_order_id: int):
        try:
            dto = self._engine.get_purchase_order(purchase_order_id)
            if not dto:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Not found", "Purchase order not found.")
                return
            # Simple read-only dialog showing lines (reuse minimal QMessageBox)
            lines = "\n".join([f"{ln.item_id}  qty:{ln.ordered_qty} rate:{ln.rate}" for ln in dto.lines]) if dto.lines else "(no lines)"
            QMessageBox.information(self, f"PO {dto.po_number}", f"Supplier ID: {dto.supplier_id}\nStatus: {dto.status}\n\nLines:\n{lines}")
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("View failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not open PO: {exc}")

    def _on_cancel_clicked(self, purchase_order_id: int):
        resp = QMessageBox.question(self, "Confirm", "Cancel this purchase order? (soft-delete)")
        if resp != QMessageBox.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self._engine.cancel_purchase_order(purchase_order_id, current_user_id=1)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Cancelled", "Purchase order cancelled.")
            self.refresh()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Cancel failed")
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not cancel PO: {exc}")

"""
screens/reset_password_screen.py

Admin-initiated password reset dialog - Medical ERP V2. Mirrors the
company_form_screen.py pattern (thin UI, no SQL/business logic).
Calls UserEngine.reset_password(), which forces the target user to
change their password on next login.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional

from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence, QShortcut
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QWidget

from engines.exceptions import RecordNotFoundError, ValidationError
from engines.user_engine import UserEngine
from ui.ui_reset_password import Ui_ResetPasswordDialog
from utils.integration_adapters import get_current_user_id, show_error, show_success
from utils.password_field_helper import attach_show_password_toggle

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ResetPasswordScreen(QDialog):
    """Admin resets another user's password. Always operates on an existing user_id."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None,
        user_id: Optional[int] = None,
        username: str = "",
        engine: Optional[UserEngine] = None,
        current_user_id: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.ui = Ui_ResetPasswordDialog()
        self.ui.setupUi(self)

        self._engine = engine or UserEngine()
        self._user_id = user_id
        self._current_user_id = current_user_id

        self.ui.lbl_target_user.setText(username)
        self.ui.chk_force_change_on_login.setChecked(True)
        attach_show_password_toggle(self.ui.input_new_password)
        attach_show_password_toggle(self.ui.input_confirm_password)
        password_rule_hint = "Min 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase, digit & special character."
        self.ui.input_new_password.setToolTip(password_rule_hint)
        self.ui.input_new_password.setPlaceholderText(password_rule_hint)

        self._connect_signals()
        self._setup_shortcuts()
        self.ui.input_new_password.setFocus()

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.ui.btn_reset.clicked.connect(self._on_reset_clicked)
        self.ui.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)

    def _setup_shortcuts(self) -> None:
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+S"), self).activated.connect(self._on_reset_clicked)

    def _show_validation_message(self, message: str) -> None:
        if message:
            show_error(self, "User Master", message)

    def _on_reset_clicked(self) -> None:
        self._show_validation_message("")

        if self._user_id is None:
            self._show_validation_message("No user selected.")
            return

        new_password = self.ui.input_new_password.text()
        confirm_password = self.ui.input_confirm_password.text()

        if new_password != confirm_password:
            self._show_validation_message("New Password and Confirm Password do not match.")
            return

        try:
            self._engine.reset_password(
                self._user_id, new_password, reset_by=self._current_user_id
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            self._show_validation_message("; ".join(exc.errors))
            return
        except RecordNotFoundError as exc:
            self._show_validation_message(str(exc))
            return
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("Failed to reset password for user %s.", self._user_id)
            self._show_validation_message(f"Failed to reset password: {exc}")
            return

        show_success(self, "User Master", "Password reset successfully.")
        self.accept()


__all__ = ["ResetPasswordScreen"]

"""
=========================================================
Medical ERP V2
Settings Screen
---------------------------------------------------------
Screen layer for the Settings module. Builds one editable
row per setting at runtime (based on each setting's
data_type), and wires Save / Apply / Restore Default /
Import / Export / Close / Search against the Settings
Engine — the ONLY sanctioned read/write path for settings.

=========================================================
ASSUMED INTERFACES — VERIFY AGAINST YOUR REAL SOURCE FILES
=========================================================
This screen was written without access to the real source
of settings_engine.py / session_manager.py / message.py
(built in separate chat sessions). The exact interfaces
below are ASSUMED. If your real files differ, this file
will raise AttributeError/TypeError at the matching call
site — tell Claude the real signature and it will be
patched in one edit, same as the SupplierEngine/date_engine
mismatch that was found and fixed earlier in this project.

engines/settings_engine.py — CONFIRMED against the real file.
It is a function-based module (like date_engine.py), not a
class. Called as settings_engine.<function>(...) directly:

    load_all_settings() -> None
    refresh_cache() -> None
    get_setting(key: str, default=None)
    get_settings_grouped() -> dict[str, list[dict]]
        Keys = setting_group. Each dict has:
        setting_key, setting_value, setting_group, data_type,
        default_value, description, is_editable, display_order.
    search_settings(search_text: str) -> list[dict]
    save_setting(key: str, new_value: str, updated_by: str,
                 reason: str = "") -> tuple[bool, str]
        Does NOT raise on invalid input — returns (success, message).
    apply_setting_temporarily(key: str, new_value: str) -> tuple[bool, str]
    reset_setting_to_default(key: str, updated_by: str) -> tuple[bool, str]
    requires_restart(setting_group: str) -> bool
        Per GROUP, not per individual setting key.
    export_settings(file_path: str) -> tuple[bool, str]
        Always exports everything — no per-group filtering.
    import_settings(file_path: str, updated_by: str) -> tuple[bool, str]
    get_setting_history(key: str) -> list[dict]
    get_recent_changes(limit: int = 10) -> list[dict]

session_manager (engines/session_manager.py):
    get_current_session() -> dict | None   (CONFIRMED)
    (Dict key names for username/role are still being verified —
    see _get_current_username()/_is_admin_user() below.)

utils/message.py (CONFIRMED against the real file — no parent argument):
    show_info(message: str, title: str = APP_TITLE) -> None
    show_success(message: str, title: str = APP_TITLE) -> None
    show_warning(message: str, title: str = APP_TITLE) -> None
    show_error(message: str, title: str = APP_TITLE) -> None
    confirm(message: str, title: str = APP_TITLE) -> bool
=========================================================
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDateEdit,
    QDoubleSpinBox,
    QFileDialog,
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QSpacerItem,
    QSpinBox,
    QSizePolicy,
